# Catalog service API

Reads and maintains catalog products with their categories, subcategories and typed details, and imports products from an Excel workbook.

Generated from the committed OpenAPI document [CatalogService.openapi3.json](../../api/CatalogService.openapi3.json) (`npm run docs:registry`); the elements of each entity with their types are in [DOMAIN-MODEL.md](../../registry/DOMAIN-MODEL.md). A description here is a doc comment in `db/` or `srv/`: change it there and regenerate.

## Access

- Service root: `/odata/v4/catalog` (OData 4.01).
- Authentication: the OpenAPI document declares no security scheme; the roles and restrictions of the service are in [SERVICES.md](../../registry/SERVICES.md).
- Swagger UI while `npm run watch` runs (development only): <http://localhost:4004/$api-docs/odata/v4/catalog>.

## Entity sets

| Entity set | What it holds | Operations | Domain page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Categories | Product category, a read-only code list. | read |  |
| Currencies |  | read, create, update, delete |  |
| DetailAttributes | Characteristic a product can carry, with its value type, unit and limits, a read-only code list. | read |  |
| DetailListValues | Allowed value of a LIST or MULTI_LIST attribute, a read-only code list. | read |  |
| DetailValueTypes | Value type of a detail attribute, a read-only code list. | read |  |
| Permissions | Tells the caller whether the current user may change the catalog. | read |  |
| ProductDetailSelections | Selected list value of a MULTI_LIST detail row, written only through the product's draft. | read, create, update, delete |  |
| ProductDetails | Detail row of a product: one attribute and its typed value, written only through the product's draft. | read, create, update, delete |  |
| Products | Product sold in the catalog, created and changed through a draft. | read, create, update, delete, draft |  |
| Subcategories | Product subcategory within one category, a read-only code list. | read |  |
| SubcategoryAttributes | Detail attribute assigned to a subcategory, with the position of its field in a product's details. | read |  |

## Actions

| Action | Bound to | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| importProducts | Products | Creates active products from an uploaded xlsx workbook, all-or-nothing. |
